rationale: The text describes sales-task automation, CRM syncing, and opportunity management, but 'next best action' signals recommendation functionality without explaining its mechanism. Non-AI is the best-supported forced choice; that unexplained capability prevents a supported negative.
evidence_spans: automates the manual tasks that hold you back and gives you the next best action to propel deals forward.
all your activity is automatically synced back to the CRM.
Manage opportunities from creation to close
conflict_response: I do not treat conventional task automation as resolving the separate 'next best action' claim: the text indicates an action recommendation but supplies no method or affirmative AI signal. Therefore non-AI remains the best-supported binary outcome, but only weakly and as a forced decision.
